## What's new

### 🎮 C and Capture were swapped — fixed
Byte 4 of the input report is `0x01` Home, `0x02` **Capture**, `0x04` GR, `0x08` GL, `0x10` **C**. Up to v1.2.4 the bridge read them the other way round, so pressing Capture fired the (unmapped by default) C button, and C fired Capture. This affected the keyboard bridge and the DSU Touch button. Three independent sources agree on the correct layout: [ndeadly/switch2_controller_research](https://github.com/ndeadly/switch2_controller_research), [espp #765](https://github.com/esp-cpp/espp/pull/765), and the hardware capture in #14.

### 🕹️ Factory stick calibration
At connect, the bridge now reads each controller's own stick calibration over the BLE command channel, then lights the player 1 LED. Real stick travel is only ~1500–1770 counts rather than the nominal 2048, so previously a fully pushed stick topped out around 0.8 in DSU and the resting centre could drift by up to ~110 counts. The menubar shows *sticks calibrated* when this works. If the controller doesn't answer, nothing changes compared to v1.2.4.
Protocol details from #14 and [kennethreitz's fork](https://github.com/kennethreitz/switch2bridge-macos/tree/real-gamepad-output), based on [BlueRetro #1249](https://github.com/darthcloud/BlueRetro/issues/1249). Thanks!

### 🔧 Hardening
- `mappings.json` is now written atomically, so a crash can no longer leave a truncated file.
- `"dsu": { "enabled": "false" }` (a string) no longer turns the server on. A warning is shown instead.
- A warning appears when the DSU server listens on a non-local address.
- DSU socket: dropped `SO_REUSEADDR`, which is useless for UDP and let two servers share a port on some systems.
- No more lost error/notice messages between the BLE thread and the menubar.

### 📦 Build & requirements
- **Python 3.10+** is now required to run from source (bleak 3 needs it).
- Dependencies are capped at their current major versions, and `py2app` has moved to `requirements-build.txt`.
- CI now tests Python 3.10, 3.12 and 3.13.
- The v1.2.4 input-characteristic auto-detection (#15), which was never released on its own, ships here as well.

## Notes
- 178 automated checks (bridge + DSU) green on CI.
- ⚠️ The C/Capture fix and the calibration read are backed by the sources above but **haven't been verified on our own hardware yet**. If something's off, please open an issue with your `~/Library/Logs/Switch2Bridge/bridge.log`.

**Install**: download the DMG below and drag the app to Applications. The first launch is blocked by Gatekeeper (the app isn't notarized): on **macOS 15+** go to *System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway*; on macOS 13–14, right-click → Open. Then grant Bluetooth and Accessibility.
